trust_decision.summary: A page tag that was stored in the DB without validation (PageManager::save escapes it only for its own INSERT) is later treated as trusted and concatenated raw into SQL on the page-delete paths; the fix wraps it in DbService::escape at each delete-time query.

landing_point.why: The advisory title names ApiController::deletePage; line 626 is the raw '$tag' DELETE on the links table.

fix_sites.entry_point: DELETE /api/pages/{tag} (ApiController.php:605) and POST /api/pages/{tag}/delete, which delegates at ApiController.php:684-685
page handler {Tag}/deletepage, non-orphaned branch (listing backlinks, a SELECT)
{Tag}/deletepage?confirme=oui&eraselink=oui POST: the pre-handler hook from the tags extension
fix_sites.module_kind: extension pre-handler hook in another package (tools/tags)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: tools/tags/handlers/page/__deletepage.php:14 — the '__' prefix hook in the tags extension runs before the core deletepage handler; it is linked only by a comment at handlers/page/deletepage.php:102

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report names the API controller, and the double-underscore hook lives in the optional 'tags' extension rather than the core delete path, so a solver can call it a separate feature (link cleanup), not the API delete.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: A page that is not orphaned must still delete: its incoming links rows are removed first, and the deletepage handler must still list the backlinking pages (from_tag). Pages with legitimate tags containing '.', '-', '_' or Unicode letters (WN_CAMEL_CASE_EVOLVED) must keep working, so a fix that rejects or strips tag characters breaks them.

O6_input_shapes: stored page tag (second-order, read back from the pages row at ApiController.php:622)
current request page tag via GetPageTag() ($this->tag, set from the page row at includes/YesWiki.php:251)

O7_producer.where: includes/controllers/ApiController.php:571-581 (POST /api/pages/{tag} saves any tag with no shape validation) -> includes/services/PageManager.php:329-390

O8_uncovered_routes.route: despam restore: the stored revision tag read from the pages row is concatenated raw into an UPDATE pages ... WHERE tag (same second-order stored-tag mechanism, but on a different table)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: An admin-only legacy despam action, on a different table (pages, not links) and not a delete route, so it looks unrelated to the page-delete advisory; the next query in the same file escapes the same value (despam.php:171), which looks like it is covered.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: another extension package (tools/security), 2 packages from the landing point

O8b_injection_room.sibling: the backlink lookup (from_tag where to_tag = tag) written without escape
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It is the same query as deletepage.php:93-94, and that copy was written raw.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: the bulk-delete links DELETE written with raw $tag, a third copy of the API delete logic
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It duplicates ApiController::deletePage line for line; a maintainer copying the pre-fix version would carry the raw interpolation.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: the entry first-time lookup with the escape moved or dropped, for an id_fiche read from a stored entry
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The escape sits on a separate line from the query, so a refactor could easily drop it; id_fiche is a stored tag, the same second-order source.

O9_family: SQL injection (second-order, stored identifier concatenated into a query)

services: web server or PHP built-in server for the routes
O10_build.project_tests: tests/ has PHPUnit tests for services and some controllers (tests/includes/...); there are no tests for ApiController page delete or the deletepage handlers

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Escape only ApiController.php:626 (or validate {tag} on the DELETE route), missing the stored-tag source and the two handler copies.

out_of_scope_notes: PageManager::save and savePage accept any tag shape (no WN_PAGE_TAG check), which is the root producer; tag validation at write time is a broader hardening question.
tools/attach/actions/pointimage.php:72-73 calls SavePage with bypass_acls=true on a POST-supplied pagetag (an authorisation concern, not this advisory).
unverified: Whether a tag containing a quote is reachable end to end through the router (the Symfony {tag} requirement) and through the URL-to-page parsing for the handler path, so that it gets stored.
present_in_latest for the despam route: no latest release was provided.
That despam.php:164 is reachable: it needs an admin and an existing malicious stored tag; the admin gating was read from despam.php:190-191, not traced in full.
